and_or.title: and / or
and_or.big_idea: and needs BOTH conditions to be True. or needs AT LEAST ONE to be True. That's different from how we sometimes use 'or' in everyday speech.
steps: Work out each side separately as True or False.
and: True only if both are True.
or: True if either one (or both) is True.
and_or.sense_check: A ticket for ages over 10 AND under 12: a 12-year-old fails the second check, so it's False.

not_logic.title: not
not_logic.big_idea: not flips True to False and False to True. Work out what comes after it first (including anything in brackets), then flip the result.
steps: Work that part out as True or False.
not_logic.sense_check: not (4 > 2): 4 > 2 is True, so the answer is False.
